author: Caldwell & Caldwell, 1963
evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic

note.en: A small midshipman toadfish of shallow sand in 2 to 9 m, listed by FishBase for the Caribbean off Costa Rica, Panama and Brazil; it hides buried and is known here from one record.
note.es: Un pez sapo fraile pequeño de arena somera entre 2 y 9 m, que FishBase lista para el Caribe frente a Costa Rica, Panamá y Brasil; se esconde enterrado y aquí se conoce por un solo registro.
